A company is forming a 4-member project team by randomly selecting employees from a group of 8 employees. The group consists of 4 engineers and 4 designers. Every possible selection of 4 employees is equally likely. Let the events be defined as follows: • Event A: The selected team includes at least one engineer. • Event B: The selected team consists only of designers. Which of the following option(s) is/are correct?
options: Events A and B are mutually exclusive.
Events A and B are independent.
There is only 1 favorable outcome for Event B.
correct_answer: Events A and B are mutually exclusive.
There is only 1 favorable outcome for Event B.
